title: ExportParts
description: parts.json of a replay set's export, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): written by exportRecording beside the parts in Documents/exports/replay-<recording_id>/; pnpm rec pull copies only the parts it lists. Checked by the PC tools, not by this schema: the names run 0000.part, 0001.part and so on without gaps, every part but the last is UPLOAD_PART_BYTES long, and the bytes add up to tar_bytes.

recording_version.description: Version of the session recording format.

recording_id.description: The recording's id (or the session's, for an unrecorded session).

tar_bytes.description: Size of the whole tar in bytes.

parts.description: The parts in order. At most 512 (8 GiB in 16 MiB parts).

part.title: ExportPart
part.description: One part of the export tar.

name.description: The part's file name: four digits, then .part.

bytes.description: Size in bytes, at most UPLOAD_PART_BYTES.
